triage_records.title: Effect of combined maternal and infant vitamin D supplementation on vitamin D status of exclusively breastfed infants
triage_records.relevance_rationale: The paper investigates the effect of vitamin D supplementation on vitamin D status (serum 25(OH)D) and milk antirachitic activity in exclusively breastfed infants. While it addresses the exposure (supplementation) and population (breastfed infants), the primary outcome measured is biochemical status (25(OH)D levels) rather than the clinical outcome of 'nutritional rickets' (incidence/prevention of the disease). Therefore, it provides indirect evidence regarding the prevention of rickets by showing improved vitamin D status, but does not directly report on the prevention of the clinical condition.
